decided_by: Alexander Kell (architect), AD-290; delegated to the manager 2026-11-03
rationale: AD-290 adds the archkeel.studio package with its api, workspace and server components, the cli requirement on studio, archkeel.studio in ROOT-LAYOUT and archkeel.studio.api as an enum owner in TYPES-ENUM-IN-MODEL. The calls_unresolved budget rises from 830 to 842 for twelve calls on stdlib receivers the analyzer cannot resolve: the inherited ThreadingHTTPServer and BaseHTTPRequestHandler methods, Popen.communicate, cookie and query parsing, and bytes and str methods in archkeel.studio.server, api and workspace.
